# Aunt Atossa & Josie Pye

- [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md) — Relative of — [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) — Aunt Atossa is cousin to Josie Pye's mother · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Life P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and notices changes in the community during Sunday church, including the marriage of [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) and news that [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) is terminally ill. The next evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visit [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md) to drop off jelly before going to see Ruby. At the Gillis home, Ruby tries to maintain a lively facade about her social life and future plans despite her deteriorating health.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XI The Round of Life

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends return to [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) for their Sophomore year and settle comfortably into [Patty’s Place](../codex/places.md#patty-s-place). After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is unexpectedly adopted by a stray cat named [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), the girls fail to humane-euthanize him, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to keep him. [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives to chaperone the household, bringing along her own cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the Sarah-cat.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships
